subject: Muralytics: policy affirmation, COI + W9 required before PO issuance
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Sandra Lopez <s.lopez@muralytics.ai>
Cc: mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai, ben.carter@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 20 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Muralytics — insurance attestation and W9 needed prior to PO

Hi Sandra,

Thanks for the quick demo last week. We're ready to move forward with procurement but need a few compliance items before we can issue a PO. Can you please provide the following by end of day Tuesday (Dec 22) if possible: 

- Certificate of Insurance (COI) showing commercial general liability (CGL) and cyber liability limits
  - Minimum limits: General Liability $1,000,000 per occurrence / $2,000,000 aggregate; Cyber $1,000,000
- An additional insured endorsement naming "Redwood Inference, Inc., its affiliates and subsidiaries" as Additional Insured (Primary & Noncontributory)
- Waiver of Subrogation in favor of Redwood (if available)
- Policy effective dates / confirmation of continuous coverage for the contract term
- W9 (PDF) for vendor tax setup
- List of subcontractors (if any) and confirmation that any subcontractors will be covered by your policy or declared on the COI

I've attached our standard onboarding form (Redwood_Onboarding_Form.pdf) — please return the completed form with the COI and endorsement documents. Once procurement confirms the documentation meets requirements we'll issue a PO and share the PO number and invoice routing.

If you expect any delays or issues with the endorsement language, let me know and I can loop in legal.

Thanks,

Neha Kapoor
Senior Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference

1) For the additional insured wording, is the exact required text "Redwood Inference, Inc., its affiliates and subsidiaries" sufficient, or do you need a specific address included?
2) Is the waiver of subrogation mandatory for cyber, or only for general liability?

We're also attaching a draft W9; if you need it on company letterhead we can provide that.

Hi Sandra / Neha —

Quick note from procurement/legal alignment: please ensure the endorsement reads as follows (this is the exact language our insurance team requires):

"Redwood Inference, Inc., its affiliates and subsidiaries are named as Additional Insured with respect to ongoing operations and completed operations, primary and noncontributory, where required by written contract."

No physical address is necessary on the endorsement; naming the entity as above is sufficient. The waiver of subrogation is required for general liability; for cyber we accept a COI showing the required limits and policy type, and will review cyber subrogation/retroactive date on a case-by-case basis for claims-made policies.

Neha — I'll sign off on issuance once we have the COI + endorsement PDF and the W9. I can also approve a conditional PO if the endorsement is in-process and COI shows the correct limits.
